source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of teamwork and knowledge sharing (PDF 190).

blocks.text: Teamwork aur knowledge sharing (ilm baantna) ka matlab hai doosron ke saath mil kar kaam karna aur maloomat ka tabadla karna:

items: Group Projects: Assignments ya projects par mil kar kaam karein aur har shakhs apni maharat (expertise) shamil kare. Misal: Science class ke group project mein students mil kar kaam karein aur apni research findings (tehqeeq ke nataij) share karein ta ke assignment mukammal ho.

Sharing Insights (samajh baantna): Seekhne ko behtar banane ke liye apne saathiyon (peers) ke saath khayalat aur ilm ka tabadla karein. Study groups ya discussions (behes) mein hissa lein ta ke mauzoo ki samajh barhe.

blocks.prompt: Ek digital tool ka naam bataiye jo team ko ilm share karne mein madad de.
blocks.explanation: Shared document ya online drive (jaise Google Docs ya Google Drive), jahan team ke sab log ek hi file mein apni research likh aur badal sakte hain.

items: Teamwork: group projects mein har ek ki maharat; sharing insights: study groups aur discussions.
